notes.note: Bounded Project header delta reviewed: local folder display, copy, and inline update are removed from the operator header; Project Settings retains the existing autocomplete and save/refusal boundary. Portable identity and resource bindings remain distinct from Git content sync. Shared member header/refresh is retained. Focused header, Settings, ProjectPage, member-page and ToolsSection suites passed (72 tests); restored old folder header made the no-directory-controls keeper fail for the intended reason, then restored source passed. Comparison and walkthrough images remain historical at their recorded capturedRevision and were not recaptured or upgraded to current pixel evidence. Existing SDK, Starter Work admission, resource authority and access behavior are unchanged.
